reason: Temporary integration-risk decision: glib 0.18.5 is tied to the GTK 0.18 API used by the Tauri/Wry Linux webview. The patch starts at glib 0.20 and cannot be substituted as a lockfile-only update. No Variant::array_iter_str or VariantStrIter caller was found in application code or the inspected GTK/GIO/Wry/Tao consumers. This is source evidence, not proof about a deployed Linux binary. Re-review the upstream GTK migration or backport and Linux runtime evidence before expiry; do not silently extend this decision.
